levels.name: Street/platform level: station building (Sdr. Stationsvej 28A) and platform 1 (track 1) on the south side; island perron 2 (tracks 2/3) and short perron 3 (tracks 4/5, 160 m, east part) to the north; north side exit to Nordre Stationsvej (Baneby)
levels.note: Platforms per Banedanmark register, all 55 cm. Slagelse is also the terminus of Lokaltog's Tølløse line (Wikipedia); which platform it uses is not stated. No owner source gives signposted level names for this station.
levels._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register dk_register), read 2026-10-30; https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/slagelse/, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slagelse_station, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Slagelse)
answers.answer: Tunnel by the station building with lifts to platform 1, perron 2, perron 3 and the north side (OSM: 4 lifts) plus stairs; Campusbroen footbridge to the west with stairs only (OSM). DSB confirms stairs and elevator.

open: Lift positions OSM only; DSB confirms elevator(s) without number or position.

Campusbroen: a Slagelse Kommune agenda of 23 Sep 2015 (https://dagsordener.slagelse.dk/vis/pdf/dagsorden/00786558-d96a-461d-9be6-b3ffd841d4ae, read 2026-10-30) said lifts were not required for the planned footbridge; OSM maps no lifts there. Not confirmed either way by an owner source.
Lokaltog (Tølløsebanen) platform at Slagelse: not identified.
DSB lists 'Andre butikker' without names; Slik Safari, Karas bagels and an unnamed shop in OSM are 50–60 m from the platforms and not confirmed as in the station.
Baneby 7-Eleven hours differ between DSB and 7-Eleven; 7-Eleven's own list used.
No owner plan found; level names not signposted in any source.
